newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador bank liquidity rose 1.1 pct in Mar 21 week.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador bank liquidity rose 1.1 pct in Mar 21 week.

text.p: Ecuador's central bank on Monday said liquidity in the banking system rose 1.1 percent, or 206 million sucres, to 18.84 billion sucres in the week to March 21.
At the end of February, bank liquidity stood at 18.37 billion sucres.
Total liquidity in the banking sector was 16.99 billion sucres at the end of 1996, up 35.8 percent from the end of the previous year.
